model.question: A spoken command to a TV, transcribed by speech recognition (it may contain recognition errors). Which action does the user want?
model.title_question: Which title does the user most likely mean?

play_title.describe: play a named movie or series, maybe a given season or episode (e.g. 'play the bear season 3 episode 2')

continue_watching.describe: continue a named title, or whatever was watched last, from where it was left (e.g. 'continue severance')

next_episode.describe: go to the next episode of what is playing (e.g. 'next episode')

previous_episode.describe: go back to the previous episode of what is playing (e.g. 'previous episode')

open_in_stremio.describe: show a title's page in Stremio without playing it (e.g. 'open the office in stremio')

youtube.describe: play or search something on YouTube (e.g. 'lofi on youtube')

twitch.describe: watch a streamer's channel on Twitch (e.g. 'put ibai on twitch')

open_app.describe: open an app such as YouTube, Stremio, Twitch, Movistar+, Prime Video, Kodi or the TV's settings (e.g. 'open stremio')

home.describe: go to the TV's home screen (e.g. 'go home')

resume.describe: resume or unpause what is paused (e.g. 'play')

skip_forward.describe: skip forward by an amount of time (e.g. 'skip 30 seconds')

skip_back.describe: go back by an amount of time (e.g. 'go back 10 seconds')

seek_to.describe: jump to a specific time or point of the current video (e.g. 'go to twelve minutes')

restart.describe: start the current video again from the beginning (e.g. 'start over')

volume_set.describe: set the volume to a number (e.g. 'volume twenty')

binge.describe: turn binge mode on or off: the next episode starting by itself (e.g. 'turn off autoplay')

sleep_timer.describe: stop or turn the TV off later or after what is playing, or cancel that timer (e.g. 'turn off in 30 minutes')

subtitles.describe: turn subtitles on or off, or change their language (e.g. 'spanish subtitles')

audio_language.describe: change the language of the audio (e.g. 'switch to the original audio')

replay.describe: go back a few seconds to hear something again (e.g. 'what did they say')

show_recent.describe: show the list of what I was watching (e.g. 'what was I watching')

show_new.describe: show new episodes of my shows (e.g. 'what's new')

pick_number.describe: choose a numbered item of the list on screen (e.g. 'number two')

latest_episode.describe: play the newest episode of a named series (e.g. 'play the latest episode of the bear')

library.describe: add to or remove from my library, or mark as watched (e.g. 'add this to my library')

skip_segment.describe: skip the intro, recap or credits that are playing (e.g. 'skip the intro')

help.describe: show the list of what I can say (e.g. 'what can you do')

none.describe: not a TV command, or not understandable (e.g. 'what time is it')

info.describe: say what is playing, or how far the user is in a named series (e.g. 'what am I watching', 'where am I in severance')

wrong.describe: the last command was misunderstood (e.g. 'that's wrong')

auto_skip_on.describe: skip intros and recaps automatically from now on (e.g. 'auto skip on')

auto_skip_off.describe: stop skipping intros and recaps automatically (e.g. 'auto skip off')

show_movies.describe: show the list of new films (e.g. 'new movies')

recommend.describe: suggest something to watch: like a given title, or a kind of film or series (e.g. 'something like dark', 'a short comedy')

find_scene.describe: jump to a moment of what is playing described in words (e.g. 'go to the part where they kiss')
